dct_description_sm: Polygon feature class of the locations of recreational track facilities within the City of Kingston, including running, athletic, and horse tracks. General Presentation, General Analysis. Attributes include a description/name and where available surface type. This data is updated only via Ortho Photo. The most recent Ortho Photo acquisition is August 2021 (Nearmap).
